messages.subject: Examples fail on cluster with error : PipeMapRed.waitOutputThreads(): subprocess failed with code 1
parts:
Hi,

I did a lot of searches before posting this but did'nt find the solution.

So I'm running RHadoop on a cluster of 3 VM running CentOS 6.4 and installed with Cloudera's CDH 4.4.

I have R installed on every node, and it runs just fine on small examples :

library(rmr2)


wordcount =
 function( input, output = NULL, pattern = " ") {
 wc.map =
 function(., lines) {
 keyval( unlist(strsplit( x = lines,split = pattern)), 1)
 }
 wc.reduce =
 function(word, counts ) {
 keyval(word, sum(counts))
 }
 mapreduce( input = input, output = output, input.format = "text", map = wc.map, reduce = wc.reduce, combine = T)
 }
hdfs.root <- 'wordcount'
hdfs.data <- file.path(hdfs.root, 'lipsum1k.txt')
hdfs.out <- file.path(hdfs.root, 'out')


out <- wordcount(hdfs.data, hdfs.out)

But as soon as I try a more complicated example like this one :

logistic.regression = 
function(input, iterations, dims, alpha) {

lr.map =          
function(., M) {
Y = M[,1] 
X = M[,-1]
keyval(1, Y * X * g(-Y * as.numeric(X %*% t(plane))))
}
lr.reduce =
function(k, Z) 
keyval(k, t(as.matrix(apply(Z,2,sum))))

plane = t( rep(0, dims) )
g = function(z) 1/( 1 + exp(-z) )

for ( i in 1:iterations ) {
gradient = values( from.dfs( mapreduce( input, input.format=make.input.format("csv",sep=";"), map = lr.map, reduce = lr.reduce, combine = T ) ) )
plane = plane + alpha * gradient 
}
plane
}

out <- logistic.regression(file.path("donuts_modif.csv"), 100, 8, 0.5)

It fail with this message :
Error in mr(map = map, reduce = reduce, combine = combine, vectorized.reduce, : hadoop streaming failed with error code 1
